description: Defines an in-memory cache class for embeddings with methods for get, set, delete, and key iteration, and an initialization method for integrating with a cache pool.

classes.name: InMemoryEmbeddingCache
classes.description: Implements an in-memory cache for embeddings with initialization logic to connect with external cache pool.

classes.name: InMemoryEmbeddingCacheExtended
classes.description: Extends BaseStore to provide in-memory key-value storage with batch operations and key iteration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the cache with data from an external cache pool and sets up methods for cache operations.

methods.name: mget
methods.description: Retrieves multiple values by keys from the in-memory store.

methods.name: mset
methods.description: Sets multiple key-value pairs in the in-memory store.

methods.name: mdelete
methods.description: Deletes multiple keys from the in-memory store.

methods.name: yieldKeys
methods.description: Asynchronously yields keys from the store, optionally filtered by prefix.
